ValidationRule.description: A quote that needs Deal Desk approval cannot be Presented or Accepted until it is approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Requires_Deal_Desk_Approval__c, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, "Approved")), OR( ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c, "Presented"), ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Status__c, "Accepted") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote needs Deal Desk approval before it can be presented or accepted.
